name: genpark-personal-agent-auditory-acoustic-decibel-dosimeter-skill
description: Calculates cumulative noise dose percentage under NIOSH and OSHA standards, 8-hour TWA, Leq continuous sound level, and models Temporary Threshold Shift (TTS) recovery.

tools.name: calculate_cumulative_noise_dose
tools.description: Calculates cumulative noise dose percentage (%), 8-hour TWA, and equivalent sound level (Leq).

parameters.sound_exposures_json: string (JSON array of sound exposure objects with sound_pressure_level_dba and duration_hours)

tools.name: estimate_temporary_threshold_shift_recovery
tools.description: Estimates Temporary Threshold Shift (TTS in dB) and quiet recovery time in hours.
